title: [X11] Unhandled XServer error: BadWindow when opening KDE Plasma application launcher with embedded game active
body:
### Tested versions

4.4-stable 4c311cbee (downloaded from website, and when built locally from source)

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 09 Jan 2025 13:22:24 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (nvidia; 565.77) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12600K (16 threads)

### Issue description

With Godot not even the focused window, not interacting with it at all, various actions cause the following error:

```
ERROR: Unhandled XServer error: BadWindow (invalid Window parameter)
   Major opcode of failed request: 20
   Serial number of failed request: 0
   Current serial number in output stream: 29448
```

Importantly, this does not hang or crash the program. It just prints an error and continues as normal.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7c0e3c72-4787-4aaa-8bab-71ff1143664e

### Steps to reproduce

Run a simple scene with a Node3D and a camera from the editor, then start doing things outside of godot, such as:

- Opening and closing the KDE Plasma application launcher
- Taking screenshots with spectacle
- Closing other programs

Occasionally, the error will be printed to the console.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[MRP.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19194746/MRP.zip)
